title: Body Asymmetry
author: Cristina Zogmaister
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baspiedn

steps.title: Record pixel coordinates
steps.instruction: Open the body‑shape image and, using an image‑analysis program, record the X‑ and Y‑pixel coordinates of the following points: x1 = top of head, x2 = chin, x3 = navel; left elbow (x4a, y4a), right elbow (x4b, y4b); left shoulder (x5a, y5a), right shoulder (x5b, y5b); left hip (x6a, y6a), right hip (x6b, y6b); left hand tip (x7a, y7a), right hand tip (x7b, y7b); external left leg border (x8a, y8a), external right leg border (x8b, y8b). Enter all values in a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Calculate horizontal centre
steps.instruction: Compute the X‑coordinate of the body centre (Xcenter) as the mean of the X‑values of all eight body parts: Xcenter = mean( X1, X2, X3, mean(X4a, X4b), mean(X5a, X5b), mean(X6a, X6b), mean(X7a, X7b), mean(X8a, X8b) ).

steps.title: Compute distances for unique points
steps.instruction: For the three single‑point landmarks, calculate the absolute horizontal distance to the centre: dist1 = abs(X1 ‑ Xcenter), dist2 = abs(X2 ‑ Xcenter), dist3 = abs(X3 ‑ Xcenter).

steps.title: Create mirror coordinates
steps.instruction: For each right‑side point, generate its mirror X‑coordinate across the centre: x4b_s = 2*Xcenter ‑ x4b; x5b_s = 2*Xcenter ‑ x5b; x6b_s = 2*Xcenter ‑ x6b; x7b_s = 2*Xcenter ‑ x7b; x8b_s = 2*Xcenter ‑ x8b.

steps.title: Derive overall asymmetry index
steps.instruction: Sum all eight distance values to obtain the Asymmetry Body Posture Index (ABPI): asymmetry = sum(dist1, dist2, dist3, dist4, dist5, dist6, dist7, dist8).

steps.title: Optional SPSS implementation
steps.instruction:
The same calculations can be performed in SPSS using the following syntax (replace variable names with those in your dataset):

COMPUTE Xcenter = mean(X1,X2,X3,mean(X4a,X4b),mean(X5a,X5b),mean(X6a,X6b),mean(X7a,X7b),mean(X8a,X8b)).
EXECUTE.
COMPUTE dist1=abs(X1-Xcenter).
COMPUTE dist2=abs(X2-Xcenter).
COMPUTE dist3=abs(X3-Xcenter).
COMPUTE x4b_s = Xcenter*2 - x4b.
COMPUTE x5b_s = Xcenter*2 - x5b.
COMPUTE x6b_s = Xcenter*2 - x6b.
COMPUTE x7b_s = Xcenter*2 - x7b.
COMPUTE x8b_s = Xcenter*2 - x8b.
COMPUTE dist4=sqrt((x4a-x4b_s)*(x4a-x4b_s)+(y4a-y4b)*(y4a-y4b)).
COMPUTE dist5=sqrt((x5a-x5b_s)*(x5a-x5b_s)+(y5a-y5b)*(y5a-y5b)).
COMPUTE dist6=sqrt((x6a-x6b_s)*(x6a-x6b_s)+(y6a-y6b)*(y6a-y6b)).
COMPUTE dist7=sqrt((x7a-x7b_s)*(x7a-x7b_s)+(y7a-y7b)*(y7a-y7b)).
COMPUTE dist8=sqrt((x8a-x8b_s)*(x8a-x8b_s)+(y8a-y8b)*(y8a-y8b)).
EXECUTE.
COMPUTE asymmetry=sum(dist1,dist2,dist3,dist4,dist5,dist6,dist7,dist8).
EXECUTE.
